metadata.description: Marketing analytics plugins for Sealmetrics consentless analytics.

plugins.name: seal-copilot
plugins.description: AI marketing optimization analyst for Sealmetrics: diagnoses performance, finds revenue opportunities, audits catalog friction per SKU, monitors carts intraday, and turns a sentence into a scheduled alert — all from 100% of your traffic, no consent sampling.

plugins.name: seal-install
plugins.description: Installs Sealmetrics on a site from scratch: creates the site, places the tracking snippet, verifies the first hit, and instruments the funnel. Carries the local MCP server, the only one that exposes the provisioning and verification tools.
